name: Card Payment Acquiring
definition: Payment processes initiated by a payment card.

CardPaymentService.name: Card Payment Service
CardPaymentService.definition: Type of service provided by the transaction.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the POI (Point Of Interaction).

TransactionDateTime.name: Transaction Date Time
TransactionDateTime.definition: Local date and time of the transaction assigned by the POI (Point Of Interaction).

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Data related to the interface of an integrated circuit card application.

CardPresent.name: Card Present
CardPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated by a card physically present or not.

CardholderPresent.name: Cardholder Present
CardholderPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated in presence of the cardholder or not.

OnLineContext.name: On Line Context
OnLineContext.definition: On-line or off-line context of the transaction.

AttendanceContext.name: Attendance Context
AttendanceContext.definition: Human attendance at the POI location during the transaction.

TransactionEnvironment.name: Transaction Environment
TransactionEnvironment.definition: Indicates the environment of the transaction.

TransactionChannel.name: Transaction Channel
TransactionChannel.definition: Identifies the type of the communication channels used by the cardholder to the acceptor system.

AttendantMessageCapable.name: Attendant Message Capable
AttendantMessageCapable.definition: Indicates whether a message can be sent or not on an attendant display (attendant display present or not).

AttendantLanguage.name: Attendant Language
AttendantLanguage.definition: Language used to display messages to the attendant.

CardDataEntryMode.name: Card Data Entry Mode
CardDataEntryMode.definition: Entry mode of the card data.

InitiatorTransactionIdentifier.name: Initiator Transaction Identifier
InitiatorTransactionIdentifier.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the initiating party for the recipient party.

Reversal.name: Reversal
Reversal.definition: Notify that a previous transaction has to be reversed if this original transaction has been approved by the acquirer.

InterchangeData.name: Interchange Data
InterchangeData.definition: Interchange information related to the card scheme.

UnattendedLevelCategory.name: Unattended Level Category
UnattendedLevelCategory.definition: Transaction category level on an unattended POI (Point Of Interaction).

CompletionRequired.name: Completion Required
CompletionRequired.definition: Indicates whether the acquirer requires a further exchange after the completion of the transaction.

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Type of action to be performed by the POI (Point Of Interaction) system.

ActionMessage.name: Action Message
ActionMessage.definition: Message to be displayed or printed to the cardholder or the cashier.

CaptureIndicator.name: Capture Indicator
CaptureIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is captured or not.

RecipientTransactionIdentification.name: Recipient Transaction Identification
RecipientTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the recipient party for the initiating party.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Location category of the place where the merchant actually performed the transaction.

ReSubmissionCounter.name: Re Submission Counter
ReSubmissionCounter.definition: In case a message is sent after the consumption of goods or service, it indicates the number of times the authorisation has been sent to the Acquirer in order to get an approval.

BusinessArea.name: Business Area
BusinessArea.definition: Defines the business context of this transaction that could imply specific scheme rules.

PointOfInteraction.name: Point Of Interaction
PointOfInteraction.definition: Describes the Point of Interaction through which the payment by card was initiated.

RelatedCardPayment.name: Related Card Payment
RelatedCardPayment.definition: Card payment which is at the origin of the acquiring process.

TMSTrigger.name: TMS Trigger
TMSTrigger.definition: Instructs the POI (Point Of Interaction) how to contact the host of the terminal management system (TMS), to initiate the maintenance of the terminal.

Validation.name: Validation
Validation.definition: Results and parameters of the card payment verification.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country of the merchant where the transaction took place.
